relations.description: UE not configured with T3245 establishes specific requirements when receiving unprotected reject messages.
REGISTRATION REJECT message may be received without integrity protection.
SERVICE REJECT message may be received without integrity protection.
Specific 5GMM causes guard the UE requirements for unprotected reject messages.
